excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, short black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a light red tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, red shorts and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Scraping Brittle Matrix from a Duck-Billed Mummy Block

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_5 uses a fine field trowel to steadily shave down thin sheets of a soft forest green-grey claystone matrix on an open coastal lowland hill slope. Her delicate scraping parts the fine sedimentary rock to uncover the fossilized skin impressions covering the limb bones of an Edmontosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
